title: 昂斯特壓縮空氣儲能電站
titleEn: Huntorf Compressed Air Energy Storage Plant
subcategoryTitle: 機械、壓縮空氣與熱儲能
summary: 德國的亨托夫電廠 1978 年啟用，是世界第一座壓縮空氣儲能電廠：夜裡用便宜的電把空氣壓進地下六七百公尺深的兩個鹽穴，白天放出來與天然氣一起燃燒、推動 290 MW 的渦輪機，幾分鐘內就能滿載。它在壓縮時把熱丟掉、發電時再燒氣補回來，所以不算純粹的儲能。課程定量分析它的效率、壓縮的溫升、節流的損失、造穴的用水與充放電的時間比。
summaryEn: Huntorf in Germany, opened in 1978, was the world's first compressed air energy storage plant: cheap night power pushes air into two salt caverns six or seven hundred metres down, and by day it is released to burn with natural gas and drive a 290 MW turbine, at full load within minutes. It throws away heat of compression and burns gas to replace it when generating, so it is not pure storage. The course quantifies its efficiency, compression heating, throttling loss, water for making the caverns and the ratio of charge to discharge time.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：昂斯特壓縮空氣儲能電站
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Huntorf Compressed Air Energy Storage Plant
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「等溫壓縮功」與「洞穴的工作氣量」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Isothermal compression work" and "Working gas mass of a cavern": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「等溫壓縮功」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Isothermal compression work" is correct?
options: 壓縮空氣儲能以多餘電力把空氣壓入地下洞穴，需要時再釋放出來推動膨脹機。
壓縮空氣儲能只是把空氣灌進洞裡，沒有任何熱的問題。
洞穴裡的空氣可以全部放光再重新灌滿。
optionsEn: Compressed-air energy storage uses surplus electricity to force air into an underground cavern and releases it through an expander when needed.
Compressed-air storage just pumps air into a hole and involves no heat issues.
All the air in a cavern can be released and the cavern refilled from empty.
quiz.explanation: 壓縮空氣儲能以多餘電力把空氣壓入地下洞穴，需要時再釋放出來推動膨脹機。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compressed-air energy storage uses surplus electricity to force air into an underground cavern and releases it through an expander when needed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 等溫壓縮功：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Isothermal compression work: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「等溫壓縮功」如何決定「昂斯特壓縮空氣儲能電站」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Isothermal compression work” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Huntorf Compressed Air Energy Storage Plant”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 壓縮空氣儲能以多餘電力把空氣壓入地下洞穴，需要時再釋放出來推動膨脹機。把氣體由常壓壓到高壓所需的最小功是等溫過程的功，與絕對溫度及壓力比的自然對數成正比。實際壓縮機接近絕熱，空氣溫度可升到數百度：若這些壓縮熱被冷卻器丟棄，放電時就必須燃燒天然氣重新加熱；若把熱存起來再利用，就是不補燃的絕熱式系統。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compressed-air energy storage uses surplus electricity to force air into an underground cavern and releases it through an expander when needed. The minimum work to compress a gas from ambient to high pressure is that of an isothermal process, proportional to absolute temperature and the natural logarithm of pressure ratio. Real compressors are nearly adiabatic and air reaches hundreds of degrees: if that heat is discarded in coolers, natural gas must be burned to reheat the air on discharge; storing and reusing it gives an adiabatic system without firing. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：1978 年啟用，是世界第一座壓縮空氣儲能電廠
steps.observationEn: Project file: Opened in 1978, it was the world's first compressed air energy storage plant
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓縮空氣儲能只是把空氣灌進洞裡，沒有任何熱的問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compressed-air storage just pumps air into a hole and involves no heat issues." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「等溫壓縮功」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Isothermal compression work”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 等溫壓縮功
knowledge.text: 壓縮空氣儲能以多餘電力把空氣壓入地下洞穴，需要時再釋放出來推動膨脹機。把氣體由常壓壓到高壓所需的最小功是等溫過程的功，與絕對溫度及壓力比的自然對數成正比。實際壓縮機接近絕熱，空氣溫度可升到數百度：若這些壓縮熱被冷卻器丟棄，放電時就必須燃燒天然氣重新加熱；若把熱存起來再利用，就是不補燃的絕熱式系統。
knowledge.textEn: Compressed-air energy storage uses surplus electricity to force air into an underground cavern and releases it through an expander when needed. The minimum work to compress a gas from ambient to high pressure is that of an isothermal process, proportional to absolute temperature and the natural logarithm of pressure ratio. Real compressors are nearly adiabatic and air reaches hundreds of degrees: if that heat is discarded in coolers, natural gas must be burned to reheat the air on discharge; storing and reusing it gives an adiabatic system without firing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壓縮空氣儲能只是把空氣灌進洞裡，沒有任何熱的問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Compressed-air storage just pumps air into a hole and involves no heat issues. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.text: 1978 年啟用，是世界第一座壓縮空氣儲能電廠

quiz.question: 依「等溫壓縮功」的模型 w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁)，把 1 kg 空氣等溫壓縮到洞穴最高壓力所需的功最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁) for "Isothermal compression work", which value is closest to the work to compress 1 kg of air isothermally to maximum cavern pressure?
options: 184 kJ/kg
367 kJ/kg
3,671 kJ/kg
optionsEn: 184 kJ/kg
367 kJ/kg
3,671 kJ/kg
quiz.explanation: w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁)；代入 Tk = 300 K、pmax = 72 bar，得 367 kJ/kg（把 1 kg 空氣等溫壓縮到洞穴最高壓力所需的功）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁); with Tk = 300 K, pmax = 72 bar the result is 367 kJ/kg (work to compress 1 kg of air isothermally to maximum cavern pressure). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 等溫壓縮功：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Isothermal compression work: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「等溫壓縮功」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Isothermal compression work” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁)；代入 Tk = 300 K、pmax = 72 bar，得 367 kJ/kg（把 1 kg 空氣等溫壓縮到洞穴最高壓力所需的功）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 pmax 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁); with Tk = 300 K, pmax = 72 bar the result is 367 kJ/kg (work to compress 1 kg of air isothermally to maximum cavern pressure). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise pmax by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：pmax 增加 10% 時，結果變為 375 kJ/kg（+2.2%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising pmax by 10% changes the result to 375 kJ/kg (+2.2%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 367 kJ/kg（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 pmax 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 367 kJ/kg (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in pmax with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁)；代入 Tk = 300 K、pmax = 72 bar，得 367 kJ/kg（把 1 kg 空氣等溫壓縮到洞穴最高壓力所需的功）。
knowledge.textEn: w = R·T·ln(p₂/p₁); with Tk = 300 K, pmax = 72 bar the result is 367 kJ/kg (work to compress 1 kg of air isothermally to maximum cavern pressure).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: pmax 增加 10% 時，結果變為 375 kJ/kg（+2.2%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising pmax by 10% changes the result to 375 kJ/kg (+2.2%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「等溫壓縮功」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Isothermal compression work"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
火力電廠像開關一樣，想開就開、想關就關。
量測壓縮機各級的進出口壓力、溫度、流量與驅動功率，計算多變效率與中間冷卻器的移熱量，並與等溫功比較。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A thermal plant is like a switch, turned on and off at will.
Measure inlet and outlet pressure, temperature, flow and drive power of each compressor stage, compute polytropic efficiency and intercooler heat removal, and compare with isothermal work.
quiz.explanation: 量測壓縮機各級的進出口壓力、溫度、流量與驅動功率，計算多變效率與中間冷卻器的移熱量，並與等溫功比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure inlet and outlet pressure, temperature, flow and drive power of each compressor stage, compute polytropic efficiency and intercooler heat removal, and compare with isothermal work. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 等溫壓縮功：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Isothermal compression work: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「等溫壓縮功」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Isothermal compression work” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測壓縮機各級的進出口壓力、溫度、流量與驅動功率，計算多變效率與中間冷卻器的移熱量，並與等溫功比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure inlet and outlet pressure, temperature, flow and drive power of each compressor stage, compute polytropic efficiency and intercooler heat removal, and compare with isothermal work. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：系統效率的邊界要明定是否計入壓縮熱回收與補燃燃料，不同類型的壓縮空氣儲能不能直接比較單一效率數字。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The efficiency boundary must state whether compression-heat recovery and firing fuel are counted; different CAES types cannot be compared by one efficiency number.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：中間冷卻器結垢或冷卻水溫偏高時，下一級進氣溫度升高，壓縮功增加且出口溫度超限；洞穴進氣溫度過高還會影響井筒與鹽岩的穩定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fouled intercoolers or warm cooling water raise inlet temperature to the next stage, increasing compression work and pushing outlet temperature over limits, and too hot an inflow affects well and salt stability. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Measure inlet and outlet pressure, temperature, flow and drive power of each compressor stage, compute polytropic efficiency and intercooler heat removal, and compare with isothermal work.

quiz.question: 在「等溫壓縮功」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Isothermal compression work" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 中間冷卻器結垢或冷卻水溫偏高時，下一級進氣溫度升高，壓縮功增加且出口溫度超限；洞穴進氣溫度過高還會影響井筒與鹽岩的穩定。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
洞穴裡的空氣可以全部放光再重新灌滿。
optionsEn: Fouled intercoolers or warm cooling water raise inlet temperature to the next stage, increasing compression work and pushing outlet temperature over limits, and too hot an inflow affects well and salt stability.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
All the air in a cavern can be released and the cavern refilled from empty.
quiz.explanation: 中間冷卻器結垢或冷卻水溫偏高時，下一級進氣溫度升高，壓縮功增加且出口溫度超限；洞穴進氣溫度過高還會影響井筒與鹽岩的穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fouled intercoolers or warm cooling water raise inlet temperature to the next stage, increasing compression work and pushing outlet temperature over limits, and too hot an inflow affects well and salt stability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 等溫壓縮功：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Isothermal compression work: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「等溫壓縮功」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Isothermal compression work” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 中間冷卻器結垢或冷卻水溫偏高時，下一級進氣溫度升高，壓縮功增加且出口溫度超限；洞穴進氣溫度過高還會影響井筒與鹽岩的穩定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「昂斯特壓縮空氣儲能電站」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Fouled intercoolers or warm cooling water raise inlet temperature to the next stage, increasing compression work and pushing outlet temperature over limits, and too hot an inflow affects well and salt stability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Huntorf Compressed Air Energy Storage Plant”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實際壓縮機接近絕熱，空氣溫度可升到數百度：若這些壓縮熱被冷卻器丟棄，放電時就必須燃燒天然氣重新加熱；若把熱存起來再利用，就是不補燃的絕熱式系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Real compressors are nearly adiabatic and air reaches hundreds of degrees: if that heat is discarded in coolers, natural gas must be burned to reheat the air on discharge; storing and reusing it gives an adiabatic system without firing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壓縮空氣儲能只是把空氣灌進洞裡，沒有任何熱的問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Compressed-air storage just pumps air into a hole and involves no heat issues." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 中間冷卻器結垢或冷卻水溫偏高時，下一級進氣溫度升高，壓縮功增加且出口溫度超限；洞穴進氣溫度過高還會影響井筒與鹽岩的穩定。

quiz.question: 關於「洞穴的工作氣量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Working gas mass of a cavern" is correct?
options: 洞穴裡的空氣可以全部放光再重新灌滿。
壓縮空氣只是把空氣擠小，不會改變溫度。
鹽穴是在地下鹽層中以注水溶解方式造出的空腔，體積可達數十萬立方公尺；鹽岩幾乎不透氣，並會以緩慢的潛變自行癒合裂縫，是理想的儲氣容器。
optionsEn: All the air in a cavern can be released and the cavern refilled from empty.
Compressing air just squeezes it smaller without changing temperature.
A salt cavern is a void made by solution mining in an underground salt layer, with volumes up to hundreds of thousands of cubic metres.
quiz.explanation: 鹽穴是在地下鹽層中以注水溶解方式造出的空腔，體積可達數十萬立方公尺；鹽岩幾乎不透氣，並會以緩慢的潛變自行癒合裂縫，是理想的儲氣容器。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A salt cavern is a void made by solution mining in an underground salt layer, with volumes up to hundreds of thousands of cubic metres; rock salt is almost impermeable and heals cracks by slow creep, making an ideal gas container. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 洞穴的工作氣量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Working gas mass of a cavern: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「洞穴的工作氣量」如何決定「昂斯特壓縮空氣儲能電站」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Working gas mass of a cavern” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Huntorf Compressed Air Energy Storage Plant”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 鹽穴是在地下鹽層中以注水溶解方式造出的空腔，體積可達數十萬立方公尺；鹽岩幾乎不透氣，並會以緩慢的潛變自行癒合裂縫，是理想的儲氣容器。洞穴在最高與最低壓力之間運轉：最低壓力要足以支撐洞壁、防止潛變收縮，最高壓力則受上覆地層強度限制。可用的空氣質量等於兩個壓力狀態下氣體質量之差，墊底氣則永遠留在洞內。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A salt cavern is a void made by solution mining in an underground salt layer, with volumes up to hundreds of thousands of cubic metres; rock salt is almost impermeable and heals cracks by slow creep, making an ideal gas container. The cavern operates between maximum and minimum pressure: the minimum must support the walls against creep closure and the maximum is limited by overburden strength. Usable air mass is the difference between gas mass at the two pressures, while the cushion gas stays in the cavern for good. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：額定出力 290 MW，2006 年提升到 321 MW
steps.observationEn: Project file: It was rated 290 MW, raised to 321 MW in 2006
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「洞穴裡的空氣可以全部放光再重新灌滿。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All the air in a cavern can be released and the cavern refilled from empty." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.

quiz.question: 依「洞穴的工作氣量」的模型 Δm = (p_max − p_min)·V / (R·T)，最高與最低運轉壓力之間的可用空氣質量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model Δm = (p_max − p_min)·V / (R·T) for "Working gas mass of a cavern", which value is closest to the usable air mass between maximum and minimum operating pressure?
quiz.explanation: Δm = (p_max − p_min)·V / (R·T)；代入 pmax = 72 bar、pmin = 46 bar、Vcav = 310000 m³、Tk = 300 K，得 9,361 t（最高與最低運轉壓力之間的可用空氣質量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: Δm = (p_max − p_min)·V / (R·T); with pmax = 72 bar, pmin = 46 bar, Vcav = 310000 m³, Tk = 300 K the result is 9,361 t (usable air mass between maximum and minimum operating pressure). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 洞穴的工作氣量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Working gas mass of a cavern: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「洞穴的工作氣量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Working gas mass of a cavern” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Δm = (p_max − p_min)·V / (R·T)；代入 pmax = 72 bar、pmin = 46 bar、Vcav = 310000 m³、Tk = 300 K，得 9,361 t（最高與最低運轉壓力之間的可用空氣質量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Vcav 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Δm = (p_max − p_min)·V / (R·T); with pmax = 72 bar, pmin = 46 bar, Vcav = 310000 m³, Tk = 300 K the result is 9,361 t (usable air mass between maximum and minimum operating pressure). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Vcav by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Vcav 增加 10% 時，結果變為 10,297 t（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Vcav by 10% changes the result to 10,297 t (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 9,361 t（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Vcav 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 9,361 t (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Vcav with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Δm = (p_max − p_min)·V / (R·T); with pmax = 72 bar, pmin = 46 bar, Vcav = 310000 m³, Tk = 300 K the result is 9,361 t (usable air mass between maximum and minimum operating pressure).

quiz.question: 要驗證「洞穴的工作氣量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Working gas mass of a cavern"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以聲納測量洞穴的形狀與體積，以機械完整性試驗（氮氣界面法）確認井筒與洞頂的氣密性，並追蹤運轉中的壓力—質量關係。
洞穴裡的壓力越高，儲存的能量就全部用得上。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Survey cavern shape and volume by sonar, confirm tightness of well and roof with a mechanical integrity test using a nitrogen interface, and track the pressure-mass relationship in operation.
The higher the cavern pressure, the more of its stored energy is all usable.
quiz.explanation: 以聲納測量洞穴的形狀與體積，以機械完整性試驗（氮氣界面法）確認井筒與洞頂的氣密性，並追蹤運轉中的壓力—質量關係。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey cavern shape and volume by sonar, confirm tightness of well and roof with a mechanical integrity test using a nitrogen interface, and track the pressure-mass relationship in operation. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 洞穴的工作氣量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Working gas mass of a cavern: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「洞穴的工作氣量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Working gas mass of a cavern” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以聲納測量洞穴的形狀與體積，以機械完整性試驗（氮氣界面法）確認井筒與洞頂的氣密性，並追蹤運轉中的壓力—質量關係。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey cavern shape and volume by sonar, confirm tightness of well and roof with a mechanical integrity test using a nitrogen interface, and track the pressure-mass relationship in operation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：運轉規程要訂定壓力上下限、升降壓速率與低壓停留時間，並每隔數年以聲納複測洞穴體積。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Operating rules should set upper and lower pressure limits, rates of pressure change and time at low pressure, with sonar resurvey of cavern volume every few years.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：最低壓力設得太低或長期停留在低壓時，鹽岩潛變使洞穴體積逐年縮小；壓力循環過快則使洞壁因溫度變化產生張裂與剝落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With minimum pressure set too low, or long periods at low pressure, salt creep shrinks the cavern year by year, and cycling pressure too fast cracks and spalls the wall through temperature changes. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.explanationEn: With minimum pressure set too low, or long periods at low pressure, salt creep shrinks the cavern year by year, and cycling pressure too fast cracks and spalls the wall through temperature changes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
